roles.label: Public / Unauthenticated User
roles.summary: Anonymous visitor interacting with host login screens, the public Data Privacy Policy, and controlled document verification.

roles.label: All Authenticated Roles (Shared)
roles.summary: Capabilities shared by all 16 authenticated RBAC roles: host-scoped logout, CSRF/session security, own profile/photo/contacts, notification inbox, realtime tickets, and responsive web shell.

roles.label: Student
roles.summary: Enrolled student using web self-service portal and mobile personal app (appointments, queue, visit history, announcements, surveys, call slips, MI assessments, service evaluations).

roles.label: Employee
roles.summary: University employee holding all Student self-service capabilities plus exclusive access to submit and withdraw multi-student Guidance General Referrals (GGR-005).

roles.label: Department Workstation Member (Clinic, Guidance & BMG)
roles.summary: Capabilities shared across Clinic, Guidance, and BMG department workstation members and interns: Team Workspace (Tasks, Calendar, Chat web & mobile), shared scheduling slots, interdepartmental referral lifecycle, and mobile read-only queue summary.

roles.label: Clinic Intern
roles.summary: Supervised student nurse/intern (`clinic_intern`): read-only patient/inventory/isolation/clearance views, Clinic queue operation, and open encounter vitals/notes drafting (cannot seal, add addenda, or dispense).

roles.label: Clinic Staff
roles.summary: Clinic Nurse/Staff (`clinic_staff`): full Clinic clinical encounters, dispensing, batch inventory & reversals, health profiles, labs, addenda, isolation tracker, clearances, Clinic reports/PDF, and Clinic↔Guidance referrals.

roles.label: Clinic Physician
roles.summary: Clinic Physician (`clinic_physician`): holds identical seeded permission grants to Clinic Staff with explicit grant-driven physician clinical sealing, addendum, and dispensing verification.

roles.label: Clinic Administrator
roles.summary: Clinic Administrator (`clinic_admin`): extends Clinic Staff with Clinic announcements, Clinic employee access management, Clinic student intern placements, MIS sync, operational export, and Clinic/Team Archive & Restore.

roles.label: Guidance Intern
roles.summary: Supervised Guidance intern (`guidance_intern`): Guidance queue operation, intake processing, assigned case & Clients directory browsing, and psychosocial/clinical form drafting for supervisor co-sign.

roles.label: Counsellor
roles.summary: Counsellor (`counsellor`): full owned caseload management, encrypted sessions & follow-ups, safety triage, episodes, case transfers, official OGC forms (PIF/PCF/CCF/GGR/GAP/CSP/PEF/CEF), call slips, MI assessments, and evaluation token issuance.

roles.label: Guidance Supervisor
roles.summary: Guidance Supervisor (`guidance_supervisor`): extends Counsellor with cross-case oversight (`read_any`), caseload reassignment, associate/intern co-signing, announcements, question bank, surveys, evaluation moderation, activation gates, and Guidance Archive & Restore.

roles.label: Guidance Administrator
roles.summary: Guidance Administrator (`guidance_admin`): extends Guidance Supervisor with Guidance employee access management, Guidance student intern placements, Guidance legal holds, MIS sync, and operational export.

roles.label: BMG Intern
roles.summary: Supervised Facilities intern (`bmg_intern`): unit-scoped composting drum monitoring and supervised bookkeeping batch logging under BMG Team membership.

roles.label: Facilities Operator
roles.summary: Facilities Operator (`facilities_op`): BMG dashboard analytics and full bookkeeping batch lifecycle (start, contention guard, release, cancel).

roles.label: BMG Administrator
roles.summary: BMG Administrator (`bmg_admin`): extends Facilities Operator with drum unit configuration, maintenance state, rotation schedules, BMG student intern placements, operational export, and BMG/Team Archive & Restore.

roles.label: Report Viewer
roles.summary: Report Viewer (`report_viewer`): read/export tenant-scoped operational aggregate CSV and PDF reports while strictly isolated from audit ledger and admin configuration routes.

roles.label: Audit Reader
roles.summary: Audit Reader (`audit_reader`): extends Report Viewer with administrative dashboard counters, Audit Explorer cursor queries, SHA-256 hash-chain verification, and read-only institutional Archive Center inspection.

roles.label: Platform Owner (Superadmin)
roles.summary: Platform Owner (`superadmin`): break-glass local login, global RBAC assignment & catalogue, sign-in carousel, MIS sync, global intern governance, archive retention policies & global legal holds, and AI provider configuration & grants (withholds `facilities.hardware.manage` and `ai.insights.*` unless explicitly granted).

roles.label: Commissioned Hardware Operator (Explicit facilities.hardware.manage Grant)
roles.summary: BMG administrator or operator explicitly granted `facilities.hardware.manage` to commission ESP32-S3 hardware, authorize USB firmware builds, publish hardware schedules, and execute simulated/live device commands.

roles.label: Unit Staff under Explicit AI Grant (ai.insights.*)
roles.summary: Department staff granted explicit tenant/unit/role-scoped `ai.insights.*` permissions outside default role seeding to prepare, generate, recover, review, approve, and read aggregate AI insights.
